topic: Frantically flipping a calendar for a homework question, unsure how many days February has in a leap year with the worksheet due tomorrow.
core_question: How many days does February have in a leap year? (secondary: What is the longest bone in the human body?)
answer_summary: February has 29 days in a leap year.; after the topic shift: The femur (thigh bone) is the longest bone in the human body.
persona: tired and blunt; using casual slang
